summary: Backend testing for iteration 18 changes — SMS endpoints (Twilio-disabled by design), SMS RBAC, Pipeline drag-and-drop status transitions via PATCH (in_progress/completed), and Geocode background pipeline. 17/17 pytest cases pass.

minor.issue: The 503 'not configured' check fires before the job lookup — correct behavior — but the docstring says it reminds the customer attached to a job. Consider 200-with-skip vs 503 when the org never plans to use Twilio. Non-blocking; current behavior is unambiguous.

critical_code_review_comments: sms_service.is_enabled() correctly gates all four SMS endpoints with a 503 + helpful message — clean implementation.
RBAC on /api/sms/* properly excludes technician role (verified via tech@a1fieldpro.com → 403).

geocode_service.py refactor preserves the public signature `geocode(address) -> dict|None`, adds provider fallback (Mapbox → Google → Nominatim), and uses a 7-day negative cache. Nominatim throttle (1 req/sec) is module-global which is fine because of the `_lock`.
geocode_cache verified populated (13 docs, source=nominatim) — fallback path works in absence of MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY.

Pipeline PATCH /api/jobs/{id} accepts status='in_progress' and status='completed' transitions cleanly; activity log + customer status sync trigger inside jobs.py update_job — verified by GET-after-PATCH persistence checks.
Job status Literal in deps.py now includes 'in_progress' and 'completed' explicitly — matches the new always-visible columns in Pipeline.jsx.
sms.py uses asyncio.to_thread for the blocking Twilio SDK — good (won't block the event loop when Twilio is later configured).
Code quality: routers/sms.py is 177 lines, sms_service.py is 65 lines, geocode_service.py is 142 lines — all under the 700-line guideline.
MongoDB _id correctly excluded across all SMS and geocode reads ({'_id': 0} projection).

Suggestion (non-blocking): add a /api/sms/test endpoint or dry-run flag so owners can verify Twilio config before enabling production sends. Current `is_enabled` returns only the flag — UI can't surface 'wrong number format' vs 'auth failed' without a real send.
test_credentials: demo@a1fieldpro.com / Demo1234! (owner), tech@a1fieldpro.com / Demo1234! (technician — used for 403 RBAC), dispatcher@a1fieldpro.com / Demo1234! (loaded fixture). Source: /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_iter18-prefixed jobs inline and delete them at end-of-class — no leftover data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_18.py -v`. The geocode test is permissive about Nominatim 429s (soft assertion). To strictly verify the geocode_service refactor, inspect db.geocode_cache directly — currently 13 docs populated, source=nominatim, confirming fallback path works. When MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY is set in backend/.env, the same test should still pass and the cache source field will switch to 'mapbox'/'google'. SMS endpoints will start returning 200 (instead of 503) once TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID/AUTH_TOKEN/FROM_NUMBER are set — update sms test class accordingly.
rca_of_the_issue: Initial test run failed with MissingSchema because pytest doesn't auto-load /app/frontend/.env. Added a fallback loader at module import to read REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env when not already in the process env. Subsequent run: 17/17 pass in 4.16s.
